responsibility: This definition module declares the runtime interface used to register Modula-2 modules and their inter-module dependencies for initialization and finalization ordering. It belongs to the gm2 startup/shutdown subsystem and exports constructors/destructors for module sets plus RegisterModule and RequestDependant so generated code and libraries can describe module dependency graphs using module and library names, ctor/dtor callbacks, and dependency procedures.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition side of the M2Dependent pair: it exposes the dependency-management entry points and callback types used by generated code and the runtime. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/M2Dependent.mod, it does not store module records, resolve ordering, or execute init/fini callbacks.
